messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] R 3.0.1 w/ rhipe
parts:
I just recompiled myself. You'll not need to reinstall RHIPE (as you will for every other package(at least c based ones)).

That said I haven't checked if RHIPE supports massive vectors. But then one shouldn't be using RHIPE for massive vect s.

By massive I mean sizes for which R 3 was designed.
